description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating a swipe refresh layout with logging features, including UI interactions and log management.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages a fragment and logging UI, handling menu options and log display toggling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and adds fragment if none exists.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu, toggling log visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with wrappers and filters, and links log fragment for on-screen display.
